title: Introducing Chip: the virtual employee built for independent grocers
summary: A virtual employee powered by AI, built for independent grocery stores. Chip handles promotions, pricing, shelf tags, store setup, and more.
body_markdown:
Every Vori store now has a virtual employee built into the software that runs the store.


[Chip](https://www.vori.com/chip) answers questions in plain language and does the work behind them. Ask what’s moving slowest in dairy and Chip comes back with the items, the on-hand counts, and how fast each one is selling. Tell Chip to put them on promotion and it builds the promo, shows what the discount does to margin on every item, recommends how long to run it, and waits for your approval before anything reaches a shelf or a register.


Independent grocery runs on people, and people are the hardest thing to get right now. Hiring is hard, training takes weeks, and when someone leaves, the knowledge of how your store actually works walks out with them. Big chains answer this by hiring departments. A pricing team, a marketing team, analysts who do nothing but watch the numbers. Independent operators don’t have that money. They have one person wearing every hat, and most days that person is the owner.


"Chip has become our favorite new team member. He doesn’t know everything, but he knows more than I do."


— Andy


Owner at Kenny’s IGA Seafood & Grocery in Lincoln City, OR


Chip works because of where it sits.[Vori](https://www.vori.com/products) already runs checkout, pricing, ordering, receiving, inventory, loyalty, and reporting for these stores, so every sale, every invoice, every count, and every shopper visit already lives in one system. Chip isn’t querying a separate database or guessing at context. It reads the same numbers your reports run on, about the store you actually operate, which is why its answers hold up when you check them.


We didn’t guess at the job list either. In June we published[The 2026 Independent Grocery Operator Study](https://www.vori.com/blog/the-2026-independent-grocery-operator-study) , conducted by EnsembleIQ in partnership with Progressive Grocer, which asked 53 independent operators where AI would help their stores most. They named promotion management, reporting, and pricing. Those are the jobs Chip does.


Here’s what Chip handles today, how it stays accurate, and where it goes next.


## What Chip does for your store


### Plans your promotions


Ask what isn’t moving and Chip shows you what’s sitting on your shelves, with on-hand counts and weekly movement. Tell Chip to discount those items and it builds the promo, shows exactly what the discount does to margin on each one, and recommends how long to run it. You approve, and it’s live at the register.


### Tracks your performance


Ask how a department did against last year and Chip answers. Ask why a number moved and it traces the change down to the item, the vendor, and the week it happened.


### Designs your store tags


Describe the tag you want and Chip builds it in your brand colors with your logo, price, and barcode in place. Change what you don’t like, then queue the whole deal to print.


### Builds your food service menu


Describe your hot bar or deli counter and Chip builds the menu, prices every item off what your case already sells, and sets the modifiers. Change an ingredient and it updates in place.


### Handles the setup and adjustments


Chip takes the action for you instead of pointing you to a help article. Adding a cashier, configuring a lane, setting a product rule.


### And plenty more


Looks up an invoice, checks a past transaction, maps new items to your catalog, builds a draft order, tells you what’s waiting in the tag print queue, or walks anyone on your team through how something works.


"Chip is very neat… I like that it’s very user friendly and easy to use."


— Thea


Owner at Mother Earth Foods in Parkersburg, WV


## Chip speaks your team’s language


Ask Chip a question in Spanish and Chip answers in Spanish. Same for Mandarin and the other languages your team speaks.


That matters more than it sounds. In a lot of independent stores, the person closest to the problem isn’t the person who speaks English best. A department lead standing in the aisle can ask which items are running under margin and what to price them at. A receiver can ask what came in short on today’s invoice. A night manager can set up a promotion to move product that’s been sitting too long.


Nobody waits on you to translate, and more of your team can help run the store.


## Every answer shows its work


**Watch our Chief Product Officer put Chip to work:** See Chip answer real questions, dig into real numbers, and set up real work, the same way your team will.


An AI that hands you a number you can’t check is worse than no AI at all. So we built Chip the other way around.


- **You always see the source.** Every answer comes with where it came from, a help article or your own numbers.
- **Insights match your reports.** Chip pulls from the same data your reports run on, so what Chip tells you and what your reports show never disagree.
- **No guessing.** When Chip isn’t sure, Chip says so.
- **Nothing changes without you.** Chip does the legwork and hands it back. You approve every price, every promo, every user.


"I have Chip by my side to get me straight to my answer. All with the peace of mind knowing it is accurate and based on live data from my store."


— Yavuz


Owner at Fresh’r Farmers Market in Lincoln Park, NJ


## Where Chip goes from here


Chip gets better as Vori does. Every product we ship gives Chip more of your store to work with, so a store running on Vori keeps getting more out of Chip without installing anything new.


That’s the difference between buying a tool and hiring an employee. Tools stay the same. Employees get better at the job.


## See Chip in your store


Chip is built into Vori, so there’s nothing to install and nothing extra to learn.
